QuestInfo.name: Here Comes Francis
QuestInfo.0: Someone called #p3000148#, the Great Magician, just showed up. What could it be?
QuestInfo.1: Francis calls himself great and talks about the Black Wings? What could this little wiener be up to?
QuestInfo.2: Is he trying to coax you into joining the Black Wings?

0.1: Yeah, you! You're cute! You wanna join up with the greatest group in the world? \r\n#L0##bI don't even know who you are. And I do not join organizations I don't know. That's a personal rule.#l\n#k
0.2: You don't know ME?! I'm #p3000148#, the Great Magician! I also happen to be the boss of the Black Wings! Or, at least, one of the bosses... \r\n#L0##b(Black Wings? Who was talking about that?)#l\n#k
0.3: You seem like Black Wings commander material. Especially with those pigtails... \r\n#L0##bMy hair makes me a qualified leader? #l\n#k
0.4: You need to join up. I'll give you my SPECIAL recommendation. \r\n#L0##bEw... can you... give me a minute to think it over? #l\n#k
0.5: Okay, but this kind of opportunity doesn't just wait around, no matter how pretty you are.

yes.0: Don't tell me you're going to reject #p3000148#, the Great Magician!

no.0: I'll give you some time, cutie pie. Just tell me when you're ready to be join me in Black Wing bliss.

1.0: What do you think? You ready to get on the Black Wing train?\r\n#L0##bActually, I just remembered where I heard about the Black Wings, little guy.#l\n#k
1.1: L-little guy? Nobody calls me that! I'm not going to take it easy on you, just because you're pretty!\r\n#L0##b*Thwack!*#l\n#k
1.2: O, OWWWWW... W-W-W-Why did you HIT me?\r\n#L0##bI dunno, it was super fun, and you're a CREEP.#l\n#k
1.3: L-leave me alone!\r\n#L0##bToo bad for you, I'm a Nova. And Novas don't play nice with people that hurt other people. We DO play nice with the Alliance though...#l\n#k
1.4: The A, Alliance?! I-I'll crush you! I'll defeat you all!\r\n#L0##b*THWACK!*#l\n#k
1.5: I'm so sorry! My mother never paid attention to me when I was a child! Can I leave now?!\r\n#L0##bYou can go sniveling back to your cave, you little punk. And tell your stupid bosses they're about to get an Angelic Buster-sized footprint in their rear ends!#l\n#k
1.6: Yes ma'am! May I go now?

yes.0: Ugh, you will pay for this!
